{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment and channel
cross_tab = df_clean.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack('channel', fill_value=0)

# Compute segment-specific differences
diff_by_segment = cross_tab['email'] - cross_tab['paid_search']

# Get total counts per segment
total_per_segment = df_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Weighted average difference
weighted_diff = (diff_by_segment * total_per_segment).sum() / total_per_segment.sum()

# Compute raw conversion rates for email and paid_search
raw_email_rate = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
raw_paid_rate = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute raw difference
raw_diff = raw_email_rate - raw_paid_rate

# Print all required numbers explicitly as requested
print(f"Number of orders after filtering: {len(df_clean)}")
print(f"Conversion rate for email (raw): {raw_email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate for paid_search (raw): {raw_paid_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Weighted average difference (email - paid_search): {weighted_diff:.4f}")
print(f"Raw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_diff:.4f}")

# Also print the cross-tab to confirm
print(f"\nConversion rates by customer_segment and channel:\n{cross_tab}")"}
